svg.font-family: Inter,'Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB',Segoe UI,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
svg.text: Two demand curves, one view of station pressure
Shape when and how strongly passengers enter above; compare alighting demand from trains below.
Drag the blue service edges and yellow peak edges,
then use the sliders to set peak intensity.
The lower graph totals alighting demand across lines,
which changes with headways and service hours.
Set entrance demand for each exit,
then run the station and watch where queues grow.
Run the station and see how arrivals and alightings shape its queues.
